control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: audit finding - change request not applied to P-9502

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-9502 and PT-9502 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically dissipating trapped and residual energy. P-9502 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 10 August 2012 a planned field verification of P-9502 and PT-9502 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop found the identification of every energy source for the task not effective.
